implementation.admission: First ready key records pending and uses the old direct-exp loop; second matching ready key builds immutable weights; subsequent hits read them. Notready new sites create no cache root. Notready mismatches remove the old site; same-key NA may retain weights.
implementation.key: Resolved call-site, length, offset.to_bits(), sigma.to_bits(), floor boolean.
implementation.ownership: Lazy Option Arc map, one latest key per site; immutable Arc kernel with exact-length Box Float slice. Current root capacity is counted; old checkpoints can retain older roots.
implementation.arithmetic: Original exp expression; each numerator and denominator accumulation retains its original positive-zero initial value and oldest-to-newest order. No normalized weights, FMA, formula reassociation or per-bar replacement of ordinary ALMA invocation semantics.
implementation.realtime: Pure cache carries from prior successful forming state; Pine window rolls back normally. Shared metadata mutates with COW on misses; failed speculative updates preserve old branch.
implementation.profile: Existing rollingWindowValueCapacity additionally counts current ALMA coefficient Float slots; all other profile fields retain their contract.

allocationAudit.rawSampleIdentity: Every non-ms stage/sample metric for both no-ALMA controls must match sealed before0 across all binaries/repetitions. Every ALMA metric and its paired delta is recorded without requiring equality or inferring RSS.
allocationAudit.cacheStorageScope: Each active kernel retains exactly its Box length in f64 slots. The independent model constrains current-root profile capacity only; checkpoint roots may retain older kernels and metadata allocations are recorded separately.
allocationAudit.accounting: Successful System requested Layout bytes/counts; realloc removes old live size and adds new size once, peak additional requested live above entry, signed exit live delta. Excludes allocator overhead/residency and transient realloc double buffers; not RSS.
allocationAudit.timingLimit: All raw ms samples, fresh-process medians/ranges and slower observations retained. Offline instrumented timings do not prove general interpreter CPU throughput.
